items.q: What does the SEO panel show?
items.a: The page's title, description, headings, images, links, social tags and schema, all in one panel on top of the page.

items.q: Can I use it on any website, including competitors?
items.a: Yes. It reads what the page itself contains, which is public, and it does not change the site.
Yes. The SEO bookmarklet is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Does the bookmarklet send my browsing data anywhere?
items.a: No. It runs inside the page you open, and nothing is sent to us.

items.q: Can you do a deeper SEO audit for me?
items.a: Yes. Our SEO team runs full audits and reports from your own Search Console and GA4.
